title: Qwen3.6 27B IQ3_XXS 64K q8 MTP short-only on one RX 6900 XT (ROCm/HIP, COMPUTE)
purpose: Dense 27B q8 short-context route with built-in MTP draft-mtp n=3 at b512/ub256; the reduced batch size is required because long-prefix MTP prefill does not fit at the full batch.
caveats: Evidence is RX 6900 XT-specific (gfx1030, ROCm/HIP); do not generalize to RX 9070 XT or other 16GB Radeon cards.
q8_0 KV is the recommendation floor for this preset; lower KV variants are exploratory only.
The short-only batch shape means long-prompt (high-context) sustained generation has not been validated and likely does not fit on one 16GB card.

Seed rows under known_evidence mix COMPUTE and 3D_FULL_SCREEN power profiles and were captured with request-level disable_thinking; they are provenance, not evidence for this candidate's COMPUTE thinking route.
This preset is a candidate until the uncached high-context profile (unique leading nonce, cache_prompt=false, sustained generation) passes a review.
